description: Header file defining interfaces and constants for UCI configuration management in the prplMesh project, including function declarations for retrieving configuration data, enums, and macros.

methods.name: cfg_uci_get
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI configuration value for a given path.

methods.name: cfg_uci_get_wireless_bool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean wireless configuration value for a specified interface and parameter.

methods.name: cfg_uci_get_wireless_from_ifname
methods.description: Retrieves wireless configuration value based on interface name and parameter.

methods.name: cfg_uci_get_all_options_by_section_type
methods.description: Gets all options of a specific section type within a package, storing results in a map.

methods.name: cfg_uci_get_lan_interfaces
methods.description: Reads LAN interface names from network configuration, returning default if UCI call fails.
